Low insurance penetration in rural areas.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Rural areas in India continue to suffer from low insurance penetration.
Mis-selling of insurance policies poses a significant challenge to consumer trust and regulatory oversight.
Escalating health insurance costs create affordability hurdles for policyholders.
Rapidly growing digital insurance platforms demand new regulatory frameworks from IRDAI.
IRDAI's regulatory initiatives to boost financial inclusion in rural sectors are frequently tested.
Consumer protection measures against policy mis-selling are key topics for regulatory body exams.
InsurTech regulation and digital platform governance are high-yield current affairs subjects.
